text:
micah: Heads-up — EmberGrid confirmed a small preview cohort for the marketplace listing. They want lab access next week and a short benchmark pass under NDA.

tara: great. do we have bandwidth to host 2 racks in the sandbox + remote telemetry? :thinking_face:

julia: we can carve out a slot. prefer Wed/Thu morning PT for shipping windows.

arjun: need to confirm qos on networking (10G vlan + egress rules). cc infra.

elena: @embergrid-sara can you re-share the NDA link and the list of test images you’ll run?

embergrid-sara: sharing now — https://contoso/embergrid/nda-v2 (we signed last week, but here's the canonical copy). test plan attached in the doc: perf_probe, mem_stress, latency_p95.

samir: quick checklist from our side: 1) signed NDA 2) lab slot 3) image whitelist 4) telemetry bucket + retention 5) kernel/driver matrix 6) go/no-go criteria

micah: exact. also need to lock down the marketplace package metadata so listing review doesn't block launch. julia can you drive that?

julia: yup — I'll create the marketplace PR and ping product review once we have the build id.

tara: about benchmarks — we want both throughput and tail latency. ask them to run our standard harness:
```
./run_bench --model=llama-2-13b --seq=2048 --tokens=10000 --concurrency=8 --telemetry=prometheus
```

embergrid-sara: will run that harness. do you provide a wrapper for the KV cache warmup?

arjun: yes, we have a small script to pre-warm prefixes. sending snippet to you after this thread.

micah: telemetry: EmberGrid should push prometheus metrics to our ingestion endpoint (pre-auth token we provide). retention 90d for preview cohort. we will only ingest aggregated metrics.

elena: legal asks that any public-facing numbers are gated — no joint announcement until we pass regression checks.

samir: pass criteria proposal: p95 < 120ms for short queries (<=128 tokens), throughput within 20% of our baseline, no memory-growth > 2% per hour across 4h soak.

embergrid-sara: agreed to those checks. they also requested a short canary for early customers after the preview (small A/B).

julia: A/B plan is fine but gated on telemetry + signoff from product and security.

tara: logistics — shipping ETA for hardware to our SJC lab: earliest pick-up Monday EOD, arrives Tue morning, install Tue afternoon. we’ll need a 1-hour window for driver updates.

arjun: flag — installer will require root access during driver firmware flash. schedule maintenance window with infra.

micah: assign owners: julia -> marketplace PR + release checklist; arjun -> network + install; tara -> lab slot + shipping; elena -> legal + NDA confirmations; samir -> benchmark config + pass criteria; micah -> stakeholder comms and announcement gating.

embergrid-sara: thanks everyone. I'll update the partner tracker with the shipping manifest and the exact images.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: sandbox-rack-7 -> Tue 16:00 PT (pending infra window).

julia: I'll post the marketplace draft by Mon EOD. tagging @micah for review.

elena: legal will finish the amended NDA by Monday lunchtime.

micah: nice — one more: please encrypt telemetry at rest (KMS). we have to align with the private preview data policy.

samir: noted. we'll request a short retention script to scrub PII fields before ingestion.

embergrid-sara: understood. thanks all — we'll aim to have the first bench run Wed morning PT and share results in this thread. :thumbsup:
